title: two-phase atomic resolve_args correctly handles partial failure
description: resolve_args does a full read-only Phase 1 (resolve all #-keys) before mutating args in Phase 2. This means either all references resolve and args is updated, or args is returned unchanged with an error. A future contributor might suggest simplifying to single-pass (resolve-and-replace in-place). That would break the atomicity guarantee and violate RFC 8620 §3.7 which says 'the whole method MUST be rejected' if any RR fails — implying no partial mutation.
